scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web && npm run check:site && npm run check:scripts
scripts.check:api: uv run --frozen ruff check apps/api/src apps/api/tests && uv run --frozen pyright && uv run --frozen pytest -q
scripts.check:scripts: bash -n scripts/build-release.sh packaging/bin/install packaging/bin/api packaging/bin/web contrib/start.sh
scripts.check:web: npm run lint --prefix apps/web -- --quiet && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web && npm test --prefix apps/web -- --run && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:site
